text: The dataset preparation pipeline begins with the Data Sources component, gathering foundational crowd data.
This includes recordings from six video experiments, corresponding trajectory data, and ground truth annotations.
Next, the Local Region Extraction module processes the video frames to extract candidate patches for each individual.
A duplicate removal step then filters out redundant candidate regions across frames.
This yields a clean collection of distinct local regions centered around target individuals.
In the final stage, regions are labeled, categorizing pushing instances in red and non-pushing instances in green.
Finally, the dataset is partitioned into an isolated test split from Video fifty, alongside training, validation, and testing sets from the remaining videos.
